meta.title: Leonida Ledger
meta.listSource: Official PlayStation 5 trophy names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026 (cross-checked with TrueAchievements). Names and descriptions below are shown as published; every guide is written in our own words.
meta.note: Unofficial fan guide. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Sony or PlayStation. One trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude. The game has no mission replay, so keep manual saves at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story, then grind the collectibles and activities, and leave A Long Road (100% completion) for last, because it overlaps with almost everything else. Budget around 200 hours in total; the length, not the difficulty, is the real boss here. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks just by playing the start of the story — you cannot miss it. Treat it as the tutorial: learn the movement, driving and combat basics here, because everything later builds on them. If the trophy does not pop, finish the mission's final objective and let the post-mission cutscene play out. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole game that can be missed: meditate at the balcony spot at Lucia's place, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone once the chapter ends. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter, since GTA VI has no mission replay. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as the chapter ends. Chapter 2 is where both protagonists become playable together, which opens up the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and most of the free-roam activities — start chipping at those between missions instead of leaving them all for the end. Keep a manual save at the chapter start. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3's story missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. By now the robbery trophies start opening up — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations live in Chapters 3 and 4, so attempt them as they appear rather than hunting them down later. Keep rotating manual saves; there is no mission replay to fall back on. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops as the story moves into its final stretch. This is the last full chapter before the finale, so use it to clear any stranger mission strands you have open (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) — their final-mission trophies all count toward the Platinum and are easier while the story is still feeding you missions. Save manually before the chapter's big missions. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: One of only two Gold trophies: finish the final story mission and it unlocks. Before you start it, make a dedicated manual save — the game has no mission replay, and that save is your only way back to the pre-finale world for cleanup. After the credits, the map stays open, so the finale is not the end of the hunt; it is the start of the collectibles and activities grind. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically as you play the main story, so there is no special requirement — just follow the mission markers until this one appears and finish it. Like every story trophy, it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the campaign. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually longer and heavier on combat than regular missions, so stock up on ammo, armor and snacks before you start, and use cover instead of rushing. The trophy pops when the mission's final objective completes. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It comes up naturally in the campaign — play the story in order and it will appear on your map. No side requirement and nothing to prepare; just finish the mission. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Expect a set-piece mission — the name suggests a big public moment — so go in with full health and armor and follow the on-screen objectives rather than improvising. The trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Airport missions tend to mix driving and shooting in wide open spaces, so keep a fast car nearby for the driving beats and use the airport's cover during shootouts. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The military-style name points to a heavy combat operation, so bring your best weapons, full armor, and be ready for waves of enemies. Play it patiently — dying just restarts the checkpoint — and the trophy pops at the end. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: The second Gold and the real final boss: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The checklist covers the story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — in practice, earning nearly every other trophy gets you most of the way there. Track it from the pause menu's checklist, and mop up the stragglers (stunts, shooting range golds, card sets, WAiNK spots) after the story. Expect well over 100 hours beyond the campaign. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and other driving feats, tracked per stunt so repeats do not count. The trick is variety: use ramps, hills, jumps and fast cars all over the map, and mix in different vehicles, because the same jump done twice only counts once. Chip at it during free roam between missions; it is a long grind, not a hard one. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — racing, fishing, arcade games, drone racing, shooting range and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one attempt at each type is enough. Use this trophy as your tour of Leonida's side content early on, so you find the activities you actually enjoy before the big grinds. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so learn one weapon at a time, use the range's practice runs to find the timing, and save the trickiest weapons for last when your aim is warm. This is one of the hardest skill trophies in the list — expect several sessions, not one sitting. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list (42 challenges).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone race location in Leonida. Drone races are about clean lines, not raw speed — cut corners through the gates, avoid crashing into scenery, and learn each course's layout with a slow first run before going for the win. The race markers appear on the map once the activity is available. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same race 20 times. Leonida's races cover street, off-road and water, so a well-tuned car for the streets will not help you on a boat race; match the vehicle to the course. Replaying a course you already won does not add to the count, so keep moving to new race markers on the map. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, and out-fish him: pick the right bait for the spot, watch the line tension, and reel steadily instead of yanking. If you lose, you can challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Complete a full game at any arcade machine in Leonida. Walk into an arcade, pick any cabinet, and play it to the end — you do not need a high score, just a finished game. The quickest ones are the short arcade cabinets; save the long ones for when you actually want to play them. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands appear as question-mark markers around Leonida — take Andy's missions whenever they show up, and the strand ends with this trophy. If Andy's marker has not appeared yet, keep playing the story; stranger strands unlock as the chapters progress. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. The boat-themed name suggests his jobs involve the water — keep a fast boat handy for his missions and watch for his marker along the coast and canals. Complete every mission he offers in order and the trophy pops at the strand's end. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. His jobs lean toward bikes and the open road, so keep a solid motorcycle ready when his marker appears. Play his missions in order as they unlock through the story and the trophy lands at the end of the strand. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more. Stranger missions appear as markers on the map after certain story beats; take every one you see instead of walking past, because strands only finish if you keep answering their calls. Each finished strand also pops its own final-mission trophy. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. His jobs are about supply runs — moving goods from A to B — so bring a sturdy, fast vehicle and expect ambushes on the road. Answer his marker whenever it appears and play the strand through to its end. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026)
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. His strand revolves around music and the club scene, so expect missions in Vice City's nightlife spots. Take his missions in order as they unlock and the trophy pops when the strand wraps up. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Planet GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. The catch: Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 disappears once that chapter ends, and GTA VI has no mission replay, so if you leave Chapter 1 without meditating there, the trophy is locked for the whole playthrough. Do it the moment you can in Chapter 1, keep a manual save from the start of every chapter, and sweep the remaining spots after the story. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, the hunting stranger. Take Bret's hunting jobs, follow his tracking clues to the animal's territory, and take the shot cleanly — a rifle with a scope beats a close-range scramble. The animal is unique, so it only appears in the right place at the right time; if the hunt goes quiet, check Bret's marker again after more story progress. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards scattered around Leonida. Cards hide in shops, houses, hideouts and out-of-the-way spots — check every interior you enter and sweep each region methodically rather than wandering at random. You only need 3 finished sets, not every card in the game, so finish the sets you are closest to first. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida — the in-game photo/check-in style collectible. Each location only counts once, so work region by region and tick them off as you explore, instead of revisiting the same hotspots. Pair this with The Goodtime State (explore all of Leonida) and Whip It Good (100 vehicles) to cover the map efficiently. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — driving feats, combat feats, exploration goals and more. Challenges complete passively as you play, so do not grind them in isolation at first: finish the story and the activity trophies, then open the challenge list and mop up the 50 easiest remaining ones. Quick wins like stunts and races count toward several trophies at once. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: With your partner (Jason and Lucia together), build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Easiest plan: cause chaos in a quiet area away from police stations, then break line of sight, switch cars, and hide until the stars clear — the partner must still be with you when the heat dies down. Do it once both characters are playable together in Chapter 2. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the key is keeping the heat, not losing it. Pick three shops close together on a quiet street, rob each one fast, and drive straight to the next without stopping to fight the police. A fast getaway car parked outside the first shop makes the chain far easier. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive a new car, bike, boat or plane and it counts. Variety is everything: cruise different districts, try car parks, dealerships, docks and airfields, and hop into anything you have not driven before. It ticks up naturally across a full playthrough, so check your count in the stats menu before grinding the last few. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus, the slow-mo aiming mode. The setup matters: find a fight with a group of enemies bunched together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots while time is slowed — a high-damage automatic weapon helps. Gang shootouts and ambushes are the easiest places to find five targets at once. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no timetable planned. The straightforward read: get onto the airfield and take off in a plane yourself, or drive out through the runways instead of the terminal exit. Expect a wanted level for trespassing, so bring a fast plane or a fast car and be ready to run. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank while the heat is on — the description jokes that it gets hot in there. Rhinos show up around military areas; steal one, then survive the wanted level it brings with you. The tank's cannon clears roadblocks easily, but it is slow, so keep moving and do not let the police box you in. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean stealth job, not a smash-and-grab. Scout the store first, move quietly, take out or avoid the guards and cameras, grab the goods and leave before the alarm trips. If you get spotted, the attempt fails, so reload your manual save and try a quieter route instead of fighting your way out. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robbery set-pieces: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out before the response arrives — a fast getaway car and a planned escape route matter more than firepower. Vaults unlock as the story progresses, so work them off one by one instead of hunting all five at once. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — the classic GTA heist in miniature. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; ram one to a stop or block it, crack the rear doors, take the cash, then lose the wanted level it brings. A heavy vehicle for the ram and a fast car for the escape, parked nearby, is the simplest setup. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside — until the whole map is revealed. Drive the highways, take the back roads, and visit every named area; the map fills in as you go. Do it alongside the WAiNK It spots and the vehicle discoveries, since all three reward the same exploring. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang, not one total. Gangs run their own rackets in different territories, so work through the map gang by gang, hitting each crew's operation and getting clear. Expect armed resistance at every site, and a wanted level after each hit. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet moment trophy. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, sit where you can see the sea, and order a cocktail. It is a nod to the very first GTA moment, so take it slow: the trophy pops once the drink is served with the view in front of you. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style: drive a car straight through the showroom's front window. Pick a dealership, get a car inside or drive one in, then floor it through the glass. The cops will notice, so be ready to lose a wanted level right after — or just enjoy the chaos and reload. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Play a proper game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City — a throwback to GTA IV's famous bowling date. Rent a lane, follow through on your throws, and finish the game. You do not need a strike or a high score; a completed game is what counts. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: A partnership trophy with a deliberately vague description — the exact trigger was still being pinned down by the community at launch. The wording points to doing an activity together with your partner that draws a crowd, so try the duo activities (races, games, dates) with Jason and Lucia together and watch for the pop. Check the PSNProfiles guide for the confirmed trigger once hunters lock it down. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list (method unconfirmed at launch).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Make a major story choice — the trophy pops when a big decision lands, for better or worse. Story choices in GTA VI carry consequences, so keep a manual save before every major decision beat: the game has no mission replay, and a save is your only way to see the other side of a choice. Play the story and it comes to you. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail at something, then pull it off on the retry. The description points to an activity you botch once and nail the second time, so if an attempt goes wrong, do not reload: try again immediately and the trophy should pop on the success. The exact activity was still unconfirmed at launch; check the PSNProfiles guide for the locked-down trigger. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list (method unconfirmed at launch).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide
trophies.guide: Something strange happens — and the trophy pops when you see it. This is the list's mystery trophy: at launch, no guide had a confirmed unlock method, and the description reads like a random world event or an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida. Explore the weird corners of the map, chase unusual markers, and check the KeenGamer and PSNProfiles guides as hunters confirm the trigger. Do not grind blindly for this one. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (method unconfirmed); Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Planet GTA 6 trophy list
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock targets down like pins. Pick a busy sidewalk, get up to speed, and swing as you pass — a bat works best. You need the drive-by to connect while the car is moving, so do not stop to fight on foot. Source: Planet GTA 6 trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they are dirty money until a contact cleans them for a cut. Keep robbing (vaults, trucks, shops) and funnel every Marked Bill through your contacts instead of spending it raw; the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up alongside the other money trophies. Source: Output Lag GTA 6 Trophy List; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything with a price tag. The total is cumulative, so normal spending across a full playthrough covers a big chunk of it. For the remainder, buy the expensive stuff you actually want (top-tier weapons and car upgrades) rather than junk, and keep an eye on the running total in your stats. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages go up for sale on the in-game property sites as the story progresses — check the listings after each chapter, buy each one, and store a car in it to confirm the purchase stuck. The money comes back through the other money trophies, so buy them as you can afford them. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (18 Nov 2026); GTA BOOM trophy list
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game rideshare/delivery app. Open the app on the in-game phone, register a vehicle you own, and repeat with 10 different ones. Any car, bike or other ride counts as long as it is yours, so work through your garage collection. Source: GTA BOOM trophy list; Exophase trophy list.
